dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes all of the voting places available to voters for the 2022 general election. The City of Vancouver uses a Vote-Anywhere model.​​ Since 2014, voters can vote at any voting place within the City.​​

​The City operates an at-large ​​voting system.​​

​​​​Advance voting days: Octobe​​r 1, 5, 8, 11, 13​​​

​​Election day: October 15​​

​​​​​​​Voting hours for all locations are 8am to 8pm.

Note:

​UBC ​and UEL residents are only eligible to vote for School trustees.

Data currency

​​These are the voting places used for the ​City's 2022 municipal general election during advance voting and on general voting day.​​
